categories.name: temporal-patterns
categories.description: Temporal pattern blocks for formal verification of time-based properties

customDescriptions.value: Assert that a condition holds for at least N consecutive time steps — use for specifying minimum duration requirements in temporal verification
Assert that a condition holds for at most N consecutive time steps — use for specifying maximum duration constraints in temporal verification
Check whether a condition holds at exactly the Nth time step — use for verifying properties at specific points in a simulation timeline
Assert that condition P remains true until condition Q becomes true — use for specifying precedence or ordering requirements between events
Measure elapsed time in simulation steps — use for creating time-based triggers or delays in temporal property specifications
Assert that a condition becomes true within N time steps — use for specifying bounded response time requirements in temporal verification
